feedback: ## Review: Header model loading fix (T6) — REJECTED ### Summary A critical BLOCKER was found: the service worker's `models:list` response sends models as **objects** (`{ id, name, provider }`), but the ChatContext type declares `models: string[]` and the Header treats each model as a plain string. This causes rendering failures (model names display as `[object Object]`), broken active-model highlighting (string-vs-object comparison always false), and corrupted state when selecting a model. ### Blocker **Type mismatch: SW returns model objects, Header expects strings** **Files:** `extension/src/service-worker/index.ts` (line ~146), `extension/src/side-panel/ChatContext.tsx` (line 14 & 155), `extension/src/side-panel/components/Header.tsx` (lines ~100-150) 1. The SW handler for `models:list` sends `models: p.models` where `p.models` is `ModelDefinition[]` — objects with `{ id, name, provider }` fields. 2. ChatContext declares `providers: Array<{ id: string; name: string; models: string[] }>` — expecting `string[]`. 3. Header iterates with `p.models.map((model) => ...)` and treats `model` as a string: - `{model}` → renders `[object Object]` - `activeModel === model` → always false (string !== object), so highlighting never activates - `setProvider(p.id, model)` → sets `activeModel` to an object, breaking downstream `chat:send` calls **Fix:** In `ChatContext.tsx`, `loadProvidersList()` must transform the response, e.g.: ```typescript setProviders(resp.providers.map((p: any) => ({ ...p, models: p.models.map((m: any) => m.id), }))); ``` Or alternatively update the type and Header to use `model.id` / `model.name` properly. ### Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Status | |---|-----------|--------| | 1 | MOCK_PROVIDERS removed entirely | ✅ PASS (no references found) | | 2 | Header loads real providers from SW via `models:list` | ⚠️ STRUCTURALLY OK but BLOCKED by type mismatch | | 3 | Dropdown shows provider groups with their models | ⚠️ STRUCTURALLY OK but BLOCKED — renders `[object Object]` | | 4 | Clicking a model calls setProvider and closes dropdown | ⚠️ STRUCTURALLY OK but BLOCKED — sets model to object, not string | | 5 | Active model highlighted with brand color + checkmark | ❌ BLOCKED — comparison `activeModel === model` always false | | 6 | Compiled successfully | ✅ PASS (build succeeds) | ### Conclusion **Rejected.** The BLOCKER must be fixed before approval.

findings.description: Type mismatch between SW response and Header rendering: SW `models:list` sends models as `ModelDefinition[]` (objects with `id`, `name`, `provider`), but ChatContext declares `models: string[]` and Header treats each model as a string. This causes: (1) model names render as `[object Object]`, (2) active model highlighting never matches, (3) `setProvider` stores model as object breaking downstream `chat:send`.
